get.description: The process is up. Never touches the database.
The process is up and PostgreSQL answers ``SELECT 1`` (pooled engine).

post.description:
Sign in with a username and password; sets the session cookie.

Every login issues a new session; a live session on the request's cookie
is revoked. Any failure is the same ``401 invalid_credentials``. The body
carries the new session's ``csrf_token``. Needs the app's ``Origin``.
Too many attempts from one IP or for one username: ``429 rate_limited``
with ``Retry-After``, whether or not the account exists.

401.description: The username or password is incorrect.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Sign out: revoke the current session and clear the cookie.

Needs the app's ``Origin`` and the session's ``X-CSRF-Token``.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

get.description:
The signed-in user, their roles, their effective permissions and the
session's CSRF token (the same value for the whole session).

post.description:
Confirm the signed-in user's password for sensitive actions.

On success the **current** session counts as reauthenticated for 5
minutes from now (activity does not extend it; a later reauthentication
restarts it). A wrong password is ``403 reauth_failed``; the session stays
signed in and its window is unchanged. Needs the app's ``Origin`` and the
session's ``X-CSRF-Token``. After 5 wrong passwords for the user in a
15-minute window, further attempts get ``429 rate_limited`` with
``Retry-After``, without a password check; the session and its window are
unchanged.

403.description: The password is incorrect (reauth_failed), or a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Change the signed-in user's password, given the current one.

On success every session of the user ends, including this one, and a new
session replaces it: the response sets the new cookie and carries the new
session's ``csrf_token`` (the old cookie and token stop working). Any
outstanding reset link of the user stops working. A new password that
breaks the policy is ``422`` and costs no attempt. A wrong current
password is ``403 current_password_invalid``; the session stays signed in.
Wrong current passwords count against the same budget as
``POST /reauthenticate``: after 5 in 15 minutes, ``429 rate_limited`` with
``Retry-After``, without a password check and without changing the
session. Needs the app's ``Origin`` and the session's ``X-CSRF-Token``.

403.description: The current password is incorrect (current_password_invalid), or a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Invite a person for one role: a pending user without a password and a
one-time link, valid for 24 hours, shown in this response only.

The caller must be allowed to assign the role (``403 permission_denied``).
Owner, Administrator, Academic coordinator and Finance staff need a
password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes (``403
reauth_required``).

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required).

get.description:
The open invitations (pending users without a password who have a
link), latest link first. Holds no link or token.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

post.description:
Issue a new link for an open invitation; the earlier link stops
working. The same role and reauthentication rules as creating one, for
every role the user holds.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required).

post.description:
Who an invitation link is for (the username to sign in with). Changes
nothing. Needs the app's ``Origin``.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

410.description: The link is unknown, malformed, used, replaced or expired, or the invitation can no longer be redeemed (token_invalid).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Set the invited person's password and activate the account; the link
is used up. Creates no session: the person signs in on the login page.
Needs the app's ``Origin``.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

410.description: The link is unknown, malformed, used, replaced or expired, or the invitation can no longer be redeemed (token_invalid).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Issue a one-time password-reset link for another user, valid for 24
hours, shown in this response only. A new link replaces the previous one.

Needs a password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes (``403
reauth_required``). Only an Owner may reset an Owner or an Administrator,
and nobody resets their own account (``403 permission_denied``; use
``POST /api/v1/auth/password``). The user must be active (``409
user_not_active``). Their sessions end when the link is redeemed.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required).

post.description:
Who a reset link is for (the username to sign in with). Changes
nothing. Needs the app's ``Origin``.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

410.description: The link is unknown, malformed, used, replaced or expired, or the account is no longer active (token_invalid).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Set a new password with a reset link; the link is used up and every
session of the account ends. Creates no session: the person signs in on
the login page. Needs the app's ``Origin``.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

410.description: The link is unknown, malformed, used, replaced or expired, or the account is no longer active (token_invalid).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Request an account as a parent or guardian, or as a student.

Creates a pending account that cannot sign in until an Owner or
Administrator approves it. Never links or enrolls anyone. Needs the app's
``Origin``. Every request counts against the hourly limit.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

get.description:
The registration requests with ``status`` (default ``pending``),
oldest first. Holds no password data.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

post.description:
Approve a pending request: the account becomes active with the
requested role. Confirm the person's identity first, out of band.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

409.description: The request was already approved or rejected, or its account is no longer pending (registration_already_decided).

post.description:
Reject a pending request: the account is archived and can never sign
in; its username can't be used again.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

409.description: The request was already approved or rejected, or its account is no longer pending (registration_already_decided).

get.description:
Search users by part of the username or display name (not
case-sensitive; accents are not folded), filtered by one role and one
state. Sorted by display name, then username. No contact fields.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

get.description: One user's account with the caller's ``allowed_actions``.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

patch.description:
Change the display name, email or phone (fields not sent stay
unchanged; ``""`` or ``null`` clears a contact field). Contact fields are
never used to sign in. The username never changes.

403.description: The caller lacks user.manage, or may not manage this user: they must be able to assign every role the user holds; nobody changes their own state (permission_denied).

409.description: The user changed since it was loaded (version_conflict); reload and retry.

post.description:
Suspend an active user: every session ends and they cannot sign in
until reactivated. Needs a password reauthentication in the last 5
minutes.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required). Also: the caller may not manage this user, or it is their own account (permission_denied).

409.description: The user changed since it was loaded (version_conflict); reload and retry. Or the user cannot move to this state from their current one (user_state_transition_invalid), or this is the only active Owner (last_active_owner).

post.description:
Archive an active or suspended user, or cancel an open invitation (a
pending user without a password). Every session ends; the history is
kept. Needs a password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required). Also: the caller may not manage this user, or it is their own account (permission_denied).

409.description: The user changed since it was loaded (version_conflict); reload and retry. Or the user cannot move to this state from their current one (user_state_transition_invalid), or this is the only active Owner (last_active_owner).

post.description:
Reactivate a suspended or archived user. Old sessions stay ended and
the password is unchanged (a user without one needs a reset link).

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed). Also: the caller may not manage this user, or it is their own account (permission_denied).

409.description: The user changed since it was loaded (version_conflict); reload and retry. Or the user cannot move to this state from their current one (user_state_transition_invalid), or this is the only active Owner (last_active_owner).

put.description:
Replace the user's roles with ``roles`` (at least one). Owners assign
every role; Administrators every role except Administrator (only with the
``user.admin_role.assign`` delegation) and Owner. Removing a role needs
the same authority as adding it. Any change ends every session of the
user, also the caller's own when they change their own roles (the
response is still ``200``). Removing Administrator also removes the
user's delegated permissions. The same set changes nothing. Needs a
password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required). Also: the caller may not manage this user, or may not assign or remove one of the roles added or removed (permission_denied).

409.description: The user changed since it was loaded (version_conflict); reload and retry. Or the change removes owner from the only active Owner (last_active_owner); nothing changes.

put.description:
Replace an Administrator's delegated permissions with ``permissions``
(Owners only). Granting needs an Administrator who isn't archived;
removing works for any user. The Administrator stays signed in and their
next request uses the new permissions. The same set changes nothing.
Needs a password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required). Also: only an active Owner delegates (delegation_forbidden).

409.description: The user changed since it was loaded (version_conflict); reload and retry.

get.description: The audit log, newest first, filtered by record, actor and time range.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

HealthStatus.description: The success body of both health probes.

username.title: Username

InvitationCreate.title: InvitationCreate
InvitationCreate.description: Invite one person for one role (``POST /api/v1/invitations``).

invitation_url.description: APP_ORIGIN + '/invite#token=' + the one-time token. Show it once; never store or log it.

A new invitation link (``201``) or a replacement (``200`` on reissue).

``invitation_url`` holds the one-time token in its fragment. It is shown

status.title: Status

issued_at.title: Issued At

InvitationListItem.title: InvitationListItem

invitation link. Holds no token or hash.

InvitationLookup.description: Who an invitation link is for, so the page can show the username.

InvitationRedeemRequest.description: The token and the new password (``POST …/invitation/redeem``).

InvitationTokenRequest.title: InvitationTokenRequest
InvitationTokenRequest.description: The token from an invitation link (``POST …/invitation/lookup``).

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: Username and password. The bounds do not depend on any account.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description: The signed-in user's current and new password (``POST /auth/password``).

PasswordResetCreate.title: PasswordResetCreate
PasswordResetCreate.description: Issue a reset link for one user (``POST /api/v1/password-resets``).

reset_url.title: Reset Url
reset_url.description: APP_ORIGIN + '/reset#token=' + the one-time token. Show it once; never store or log it.

PasswordResetIssued.title: PasswordResetIssued
PasswordResetIssued.description:
A new password-reset link (``201``).

``reset_url`` holds the one-time token in its fragment. It is shown in this
response only: never stored, logged or returned again.

PasswordResetLookup.title: PasswordResetLookup
PasswordResetLookup.description: Who a reset link is for, so the page can show the username.

PasswordResetRedeemRequest.title: PasswordResetRedeemRequest
PasswordResetRedeemRequest.description: The token and the new password (``POST …/password-reset/redeem``).

PasswordResetTokenRequest.title: PasswordResetTokenRequest
PasswordResetTokenRequest.description: The token from a reset link (``POST …/password-reset/lookup``).

ProblemDetails.description: The body of every error response (RFC 9457 Problem Details).
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

ReauthenticateRequest.title: ReauthenticateRequest
ReauthenticateRequest.description: The current user's password (#26). The same bounds as login.

reauthenticated_until.title: Reauthenticated Until
reauthenticated_until.description: When the 5-minute reauthentication window of this session ends (ISO 8601, UTC). Activity does not extend it.

ReauthenticateResponse.title: ReauthenticateResponse
ReauthenticateResponse.description:
The end of the session's reauthentication window (#26).

Holds no token, hash or session id.

username.title: Username
username.description: Normalized like a login username: 3 to 64 characters from a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-' (letters are not case-sensitive).

RegistrationRequestItem.title: RegistrationRequestItem
RegistrationRequestItem.description: One registration request in the review list. Holds no password data.

RegistrationSubmitted.title: RegistrationSubmitted
RegistrationSubmitted.description: The answer to a registration request (``202``). Holds no id.

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: The session's CSRF token: send it as X-CSRF-Token on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. Keep it in memory only.

SessionUser.title: SessionUser
SessionUser.description:
The signed-in user (``POST /auth/login`` and ``GET /auth/me``).

Holds no password hash, session token or session id. ``csrf_token`` is
the session's CSRF token: the SPA keeps it in memory and sends it as
``X-CSRF-Token`` on ``POST``, ``PUT``, ``PATCH`` and ``DELETE``.

assignable_roles.title: Assignable Roles
assignable_roles.description: Roles the caller may add to and remove from this user, in the catalog order (empty: the roles are read-only).

manage_delegations.title: Manage Delegations
manage_delegations.description: The caller may grant and revoke this user's delegated permissions (an Owner, and the user holds administrator).

UserAllowedActions.title: UserAllowedActions
UserAllowedActions.description:
What the caller may do to this user, computed by the server with the
routes' rules (the routes stay the authority). The last-active-Owner guard
is not considered (the server answers ``409 last_active_owner``).

UserDelegationsUpdate.description:
The Administrator's complete set of delegated permissions (``PUT
/api/v1/users/{user_id}/delegations``) and the version the caller
loaded.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role codes, in the catalog order.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.description: Delegated permission codes, sorted (changed with PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/delegations).

password_set.title: Password Set
password_set.description: Whether the account has a password: a pending account without one is an open invitation, with one a registration request.

UserDetail.title: UserDetail
UserDetail.description: One user's account. Holds no password hash or token.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role codes, in the catalog order.

UserListItem.title: UserListItem
UserListItem.description:
One user in the list. No contact fields, password data or delegations
(spec §16: minimal exposure).

UserRolesUpdate.title: UserRolesUpdate
UserRolesUpdate.description:
The user's complete set of roles (``PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles``)
and the version the caller loaded. At least one role: a roleless account
is only a registration request (#169).

UserStateChange.title: UserStateChange
UserStateChange.description: Suspend, archive or reactivate: the version the caller loaded.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
A profile change (``PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id}``). Fields that are not
sent stay unchanged; ``""`` or ``null`` clears ``email`` or ``phone``. The
username never changes (ADR-0007 D7).
